newsitem.title: USA: LPC - Disney taps three banks for $5 bln refinancing.
newsitem.headline: LPC - Disney taps three banks for $5 bln refinancing.

text.p: NEW YORK, Sept 25 (LPC) - Walt Disney Co has tapped BankAmerica Corp, Citicorp's Citibank and Credit Suisse for a $5 billion refinancing bank loan, banking sources said.
The loan will refinance a $12 billion credit facility the company took out last year for its acquisition of Capital Cities/ABC, banking sources said.
The new credit is split between a $2 billion, 364-day facility and a $3 billion, five-year revolver, bankers added.
Pricing on the shorter tranche starts at 13.5 basis points over the London Interbank Offered Rate (LIBOR), plus a four-basis-point annual fee, according to bankers.
The longer tranche is priced at 11.5 basis points over LIBOR, plus a six-basis-point annual fee, bankers added.
